'''Rake-riding''' was a dangerous sport held in the [[Korsinata]], a stadium in [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] wrangled with [[uvak]] whose wings had been clipped and fitted with [[Glass/Legends|glass]] prongs for the entertainment of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. An unsuccessful [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|assassination attempt]] on [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]] was made during a rake-riding event by the [[uvak wrangler]] [[Campion Dey]] in [[3960 BBY]].
